# Humble Networks

> Humble Networks is a small team in Cape Town CBD, South Africa. We install and fix business Wi-Fi and networks, build business websites and online shops, and run monthly support plans. Every price is quoted after a site survey.

## Pages

- [Home](https://foetstech.github.io/humble-networks/index.html): what we do and how it works
- [Network](https://foetstech.github.io/humble-networks/services.html): business networks, Wi-Fi, cabling and security
- [Websites](https://foetstech.github.io/humble-networks/websites.html): landing pages, business websites and online shops
- [Support](https://foetstech.github.io/humble-networks/support.html): monthly support plans
- [About](https://foetstech.github.io/humble-networks/about.html): who we are
- [Contact](https://foetstech.github.io/humble-networks/contact.html): sales, support and general enquiries
